_comment: WPF renames for canonical properties whose surface was altered by #if or partial classes.
ApiGenerator does not run for these components: they are exposed directly in WPF, so their
canonical C# surface *is* the public API. Where TINYCLR and WPF disagree the canonical name is
the TINYCLR one -- that is what every other platform derives from -- and the WPF spelling is
recorded here as a rename off it.
One entry serves both directions. Forward: a WPF build asks for the canonical and gets the WPF
name. Reverse: a topic that wrote the WPF spelling in prose resolves to the canonical, and from
there to whatever the reader's platform calls it.
XYChart.YAxisLabelForeground is declared only in DataChart.XAML/XYChart.XAML.Properties.cs; the
canonical YAxisLabelTextColor is mapped on all six generated platforms.
